title: Seeking Line Art Finishing Artist for Graphic Novel
content: Graphic novel production seeks Line Art Finishing Artist (Remote). Work on finishing and refining line art, completing illustrated pages, and adding shadows, lighting, and final details under the Lead Artist’s direction. Requires strong character drawing and anatomy skills, knowledge of perspective and movement, clean linework, and the ability to match an established visual style. Experience with comics, sequential art, or illustrated narratives is a plus.
